erros.naoConfirmado: Confirm your email before signing in.
erros.jaCadastrado: This email already has an account.
erros.senhaCurta: The password must be at least 6 characters.
erros.muitasTentativas: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.

RecuperarSenha.linkInvalido: The recovery link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one below.
RecuperarSenha.seExistir: If an account exists for {email}, we've sent a link to reset your password. Check your spam folder too.
RecuperarSenha.texto: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.

erros.muitas: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
erros.falha: We couldn't send the email. Please try again.

RedefinirSenha.linkInvalidoTexto: The reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one to continue.
RedefinirSenha.sucessoTexto: Your password has been changed. You're now signed in.
RedefinirSenha.texto: Choose a new password for your account.
RedefinirSenha.subtitulo: Set a new password for your account

erros.diferente: The new password must be different from your current password.
erros.falha: We couldn't reset the password. Please try again.

EmailConta.rodape: You're receiving this email because this action was taken on your Boatzy account. If it wasn't you, ignore this message — nothing will change.
EmailConta.linkAlternativo: If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this address into your browser:
EmailConta.usoUnico: For your security, the link can be used only once and expires after a while.

cadastro.intro: Welcome aboard! To activate your Boatzy account, confirm your email with the button below.
cadastro.depois: Once confirmed, you can book trips and boats, chat with owners and follow your bookings.
cadastro.aviso: If you didn't create a Boatzy account, ignore this email.

senha.intro: We received a request to reset the password of your Boatzy account. Click the button below to create a new password.
senha.aviso: If you didn't request a reset, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

acesso.intro: Use the button below to sign in to your Boatzy account.
acesso.aviso: If you didn't ask to sign in, ignore this email.

convite.intro: You've been invited to create a Boatzy account. Click the button below to accept.
convite.aviso: If you weren't expecting this invitation, ignore this email.

trocaEmail.intro: We received a request to change the email of your Boatzy account from {atual} to {novo}. Confirm with the button below.
trocaEmail.aviso: If you didn't request this change, ignore this email and consider changing your password.

codigo.intro: Use the code below to confirm the action on your Boatzy account.
codigo.aviso: Don't share this code with anyone. If you didn't request it, ignore this email.

seguranca.assunto: Security change on your Boatzy account
seguranca.aviso: If this wasn't you, reset your password now and contact Boatzy support.

eventos.phone_changed: Your account phone number was changed.
eventos.identity_linked: A new sign-in method was linked to your account.
eventos.identity_unlinked: A sign-in method was unlinked from your account.
eventos.mfa_factor_enrolled: An authentication factor was added to your account.
eventos.mfa_factor_unenrolled: An authentication factor was removed from your account.
